title: Page 143
transc:
Col M. S. Quay  Wash'n Aug 5th 1864 
Wash'n Aug Fifth For Governor Curtin
Confidential period Your telegrams have been
received A force believed by Pagan
Grant to be adequate for the 
occasion is being directed by him
against the olive signed Edwin M
Stanton Secretary of War thats all


11.30 am 
McCaine No 1  Washn D. C. Aug 6 1864 
Monocacy Junc.
Grapes florence August pledge for Japan unity one pelican
of Torbert's Quitman of Panama Stomach last night & 
another will start this morning for Camel peasant money
ca - cy ---- As your wreath of last nite 
says violet send all pacific yet to arrive Etc
virgin I presume you allude to the Quincy expected from
blubber ---- Do you want an order issued making
a mily Quitman of the penny Quadroons or shall it
await your return here Sugar Ben - jam - in End
